title: Sephiria 1.0 Guide — Hard Mode, Destiny Tree, Builds
description: Just bought Sephiria 1.0? Unlock Hard Mode (Root’s Retreat), spend Destiny sapphires, then commit to one build. Short English pages with sources—not a wiki dump.
lede: Start with Hard Mode / Root’s Retreat, the Destiny Inscription tree, and one build. Each page is a single search question with sources—not AI filler.
what_html:
Sephiria is a top-down action roguelite from Team Horay (Dungreed). Full release July 31, 2026: six chapters, six weapon lines, Artifact + Tablet grid, co-op up to four. This site answers the first stuck moments—not a full wiki dump.

English-first P0 coverage. Patch-sensitive tips note when they come from older Steam Community guides.
